scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc -b tsconfig.json --pretty false && pnpm exec node ./scripts/build-electron.mjs && pnpm exec vite build
scripts.dev: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),cp=require('node:child_process');if(!fs.existsSync('scripts/dev-electron.mjs')){console.log('Skipping packaged @another-workbench/desktop dev copy.');process.exit(0)}const child=cp.spawn(process.execPath,['scripts/dev-electron.mjs'],{stdio:'inherit'});for(const sig of ['SIGINT','SIGTERM'])process.on(sig,()=>child.kill(sig));child.on('exit',(code,signal)=>signal?process.kill(process.pid,signal):process.exit(code??1))"
